name: Garage Grill & The Cliff Dining Pub (Draper) Grilled Salmon, Brioche Burger & Flatbread
brandOrRestaurant: Garage Grill / The Cliff Dining Pub / Sauce Boss (12300 S · Draper, UT)
whyItWorks: Popular Draper sit-down spots right off 12300 S near TownePlace Suites offering grilled salmon, rotisserie/grilled chicken, wood-fired flatbreads, and brioche burgers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: At Garage Grill or The Cliff, order Grilled Salmon, Grilled Chicken, or a plain Cheddar Burger on a brioche bun; at Sauce Boss Southern Kitchen, choose rotisserie/grilled chicken with mac & cheese and cornbread (skipping the spicy "Sticky Chicky" and ghost pepper wings).
watchOuts: Avoid ghost pepper coconut shrimp, Dirty Bird wings, and spicy maple hot sauce
